dog.description_text: Skinny Paws is currently on a big adventure and won’t be cruising into the adoption center for about a week. We don’t know a ton about this traveling buddy just yet, but that’s all part of the fun—we get to learn about them right alongside you! As they make their way here, we’ll share any little tidbits the transport team notices. And once Skinny Paws arrives and settles in, we’ll discover even more about their personality, preferences, and all the adorable quirks that make them one-of-a-kind. Keep an eye out for updates—Skinny Paws is on the move, and we can’t wait to learn (and share!) more of their story as it unfolds.
dog.name: Pawl
